impossible-os: Build a From-Scratch x86-64 Operating System
https://osrepos.com/repo/rizonesoft-impossible-os?utm_source=mastodon

Impossible OS is a pre-alpha 64-bit operating system built from scratch for modern x86-64 hardware, with UEFI boot, an SMP kernel, a compositing desktop, and a native Win32 API. It is aimed at OS developers and hardware testers, not daily-use systems.
